text: Place the channel so that it begins at slot 120.
The route must not cross a national border; keep the whole path domestic.
End-to-end propagation delay has to stay below 9 ms for this customer.
Go with the second-shortest candidate by km, not the shortest.
No subsea or festoon cable sections anywhere on the path, please.
Put it on the same route as the existing circuit this customer already has between these two cities.
This is the backup leg, so it must be fully link-disjoint from the working path provisioned yesterday.
Force QPSK on this lightpath whatever route you take; we need the extra margin.
Choose the candidate with the best OSNR margin.
Allocate the spectrum in the upper half of the C-band only.
first-fit please: lowest free slot index on the chosen route
Whatever you choose, it must not be the last entry in the candidate list.
Use best-fit: the smallest free block that still accommodates the request.
Leave two empty guard slots on each side of the new channel when you assign spectrum.
Prefer the lowest-order modulation on offer; robustness matters more than spectrum for this one.
The route should be at least 800 km long, since we are validating the long-haul cards.
